job.job_description:
Full Time, Remote.
Position Overview:
We are seeking a talented and passionate Generative AI & Copilot Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy AI-powered copilots and assistants that enhance user productivity, streamline workflows, and enable intelligent automation. You will work closely with product managers, data scientists, and backend engineers to build intelligent user experiences powered by Large Language Models (LLMs).
Responsibilities:
Build and deploy custom Generative AI copilots using LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, LLaMA, Mistral, etc.)
Design prompt flows, embeddings, RAG pipelines, and fine-tuning strategies for domain-specific tasks
Integrate copilots into web/internal platforms via APIs or SDKs
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify AI use cases and optimize AI-driven user experiences
Evaluate LLM performance using real-world data and improve response accuracy, tone, and relevance
Monitor latency, cost, and reliability metrics for deployed AI agents
Stay updated on GenAI tools (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pinecone, Weaviate)
Create technical documentation and support internal adoption/scaling
Ensure compliance with ethical AI usage, data privacy, and security best practices

Requirements:
Bachelor s or Master s in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML, or related field
2 5 years of experience in backend or AI/ML engineering, with recent LLM-based work
Strong programming skills in Python (JavaScript/TypeScript is a bonus)
Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or Hugging Face APIs
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks
Understanding of prompt engineering, embeddings, and vector search
Knowledge of RAG architecture, model fine-tuning, and inference optimization
Comfortable with APIs, databases, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
Strong analytical and debugging skills with a product mindset
Excellent communication and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
Bonus (Preferred Experience):
Background in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or digital risk protection
Experience building or integrating AI copilots for security operations such as:
Phishing detection
Alert triage
Threat summarization
Understanding of how Generative AI can assist in:
Automating incident response and SOC workflows
Enriching IOCs and TTPs with contextual analysis
Generating executive summaries from technical logs and threat reports
Simulating adversarial behavior (e.g., prompt-injection or red teaming models)
Assisting analysts with real-time queries using natural language interfaces
Join us and help shape the future of human-AI collaboration through powerful copilots that make everyday tasks smarter, faster, and more human.
